items.title: How To Watch And Live Stream Detroit Pistons vs Boston Celtics NBA Game This Afternoon: TV Channels, Team News, Start Time
items.summary: Game Details Date Tuesday, October 20 Start Time 3 PM ET / 2 PM CT / 12 PM PT Location Little Caesars Arena, Detroit How to Watch on TV Fans have both national and regional broadcasting options for tonight's game: National Broadcast NBC Detroit Home Broadcast WMYD (Scripps) Boston Away Broadcast NBC Sports Boston How to Live Stream If you are looking to stream the game live, you have digital platforms available depending on your location: Pistons fans in local market - Celtics fans in local market - Out-of-market fans NBA League Pass READ MORE : Full List Of NBA Regional Sports Networks Team News & What to Watch For This is the first game of the 2026-2027 season for both franchises and the league itself. With a 3PM tip-off time in the east, it's also the earliest weekday game in NBA history. After busy preseasons, the Pistons and the Celtics will be looking to get their campaigns off to the best possible start, as each head coach tries to fine tune his best team. Detroit Pistons: Detroit crashed out of the Eastern Conference semifinals by losing a tight playoff series to the Cleveland Cavaliers 3-4 in 2025-2026. Under J.B. Bickerstaff, the home team put up an impressive 3-1 record in preseason and endeavor to build on that momentum. All-NBA First Team star Cade Cunningham continues to lead the offense. Boston Celtics: Clinching the Atlantic Division and finishing second in the Eastern Conference, the Celtics lost a close first round playoffs series to the Philadelphia 76ers by a score of 3-4. They controversially traded Jaylen Brown to the City of Brotherly Love, therefore breaking up a highly successful duo with Jayson Tatum, but the good news is that Tatum has recovered from an Achilles tear in the playoffs. New York Knicks big man Mitchell Robinson will make his league debut against the Pistons for the Celtics, who went on a hot 4-0 streak in preseason which included two victories over the 76ers.
